articles.mainIdea: KBRA Assigns Preliminary Ratings to ALTDE 2026-1 Trust
articles.summary: Business Wire: KBRA Assigns Preliminary Ratings to ALTDE 2026-1 Trust. NEW YORK, April 16, 2026--KBRA assigns preliminary ratings to ALTDE 2026-1 Trust (ALTDE 2026-1), an aviation ABS transaction. ALTDE 2026-1 represents the second issuance serviced by Altavair L.P. and Altavair Limited (together, Altavair, the Company or the Servicers). Altavair was founded in 2003, and through a joint venture with KKR Credit Advisors (US) LLC (KKR) in 2018, has a managed portfolio of approximately $5.3 billion across more than 120 aircraft.
